title: Telemetry Orchestrator: correlate traces/metrics/logs into incident envelopes + autoseed postmortems
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Problem: When high-severity alerts fire we lack a reliable single "incident envelope" that ties traces, metric spikes, and key log snippets together for on-call routing and for postmortem scaffolding. This leads to noisy PD incidents, long triage times, and manual postmortem drafting.

Goal: Implement a Telemetry Orchestrator service that: 1) consumes tracing hooks, metrics breakpoints, and sampled logs, 2) correlates signals into a compact incident envelope, 3) pushes actionable attachments to PagerDuty and Slack channels, and 4) autogenerates a seeded postmortem draft in our Confluence template. The orchestrator should deduplicate similar incidents, support severity calibration, and expose a small SDK/hook for runtime components to attach context (KV-cache ids, model variant, request id).
acceptance_criteria: Incident envelope JSON schema documented and reviewed (includes top 3 traces, metric slices, representative log snippets, SLO deltas, affected routes)
PagerDuty incident payloads include the envelope as an attachment and a URL back to a console incident view
Slack alert messages use block format with actionable buttons (ack, open incident view, run rollback script) and include concise evidence
Autoseeded postmortem draft is created in Confluence with prefilled sections: timeline, root cause hypothesis, customer impact, mitigation steps
Dedupe policy: events with >=80% trace-span overlap and same root-service are merged within a 10m window
End-to-end latency from alert trigger to PD/Slack delivery <= 10s for high-severity (P0) events on hosted infra
Feature gated and opt-in per service; no PII is included in attachments by default
tasks: Design envelope schema and map fields to existing console incident model
Add tracing hook to runtime (lightweight sampler integration + envelope builder API)
Build Telemetry Orchestrator microservice: intake, correlator, deduper, notifier
Implement PD/Slack notifier adapters with retry/backoff and idempotency keys
Wire autoseed flow that creates Confluence draft via team's templates and returns link
Integrate severity calibration rules and allow manual override from Slack actions
Create telemetry: coverage dashboard, end-to-end latency metric, and error rate for orchestrator
E2E tests (simulated alert storms, dedupe correctness, slack button flows) and load test 500 EPS
